name: Notification
description: The generic single-event notification: what happened, the facts worth keeping, and one action. Scales from four elements to a full record depending on what the sender supplies.

origin.note: Design: plain notice — scales with the sender, collapses to four elements when there is little to say.

subject: {{ event_line }}
preheader: Everything worth saying is in the first line, and the link goes straight to the thing itself.

context_label.description: Small label naming the area this concerns, e.g. "Export" or "Billing". Lets someone triage the message before reading it. Omit for the barest version.

event_line.description: What happened, as a complete statement rather than a topic. This is the subject line by default, so write it once and well.

event_detail.description: One sentence of context under the headline. What it means, or what happens next.

details.description: Facts worth keeping or forwarding, as `label`/`value` pairs. Set `mono` on references someone may need to read character by character. Omit entirely for a bare notice.

deadline_label.description: Bold lead-in on the deadline bar.

deadline_text.description: When the thing expires. A notification with an expiry has exactly one job beyond the action: make the expiry impossible to miss.
deadline_text.example: 31 August, then the file is deleted

action_label.description: The one action. Name the outcome, not the mechanism.

action_url.description: Where the action goes — straight to the thing, never a generic dashboard.

secondary_label.description: Label for an optional second action of lesser weight.

secondary_url.description: Optional second action. Leave empty and the primary stands alone, which is usually right.

settings_prompt.description: Line above the frequency control, so the link is not left to speak for itself.
settings_prompt.default: You get one of these each time this happens.

notification_settings_url.description: Where notification frequency is changed. Offering it is what keeps a notification a notification rather than an imposition.

notification_settings_label.default: Change how often you get these
